note: FUJIFILM sells ETERNA Vivid 160 as its high-saturation, high-contrast cine negative and ETERNA Vivid 500 as 'a seamless match with Vivid 160', but from the KB-0701E curves alone the profile rendered no more saturated than the natural ETERNA 250 and below the F-125 / F-250 Super F stocks (C* 43.0 vs 43.3 / 44.5 / 45.9). Digitisation verified against the PDF (vector paths).
